metadata.description: Twenty-one-item self-report measure of depressive symptom severity.
metadata.intended_use: Clinical and research assessment of depressive symptom burden in adolescents and adults.
metadata.name_origin: Beck Depression Inventory, second edition, abbreviated BDI-II.
metadata.development_history: The second edition revised the original inventory to align symptom content and diagnostic criteria more closely.
metadata.measurement_rationale: A broad symptom inventory covers cognitive, affective, somatic, and behavioral aspects of depression.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Scores support severity assessment but do not replace a diagnostic interview; use the German edition's norms and license.

versions.source_citation: Beck et al. (1996). Beck Depression Inventory-II; German commercial edition.

source_documents.title: BDI-II German edition reference
source_documents.license_name: Commercial test material; edition and use terms apply
source_documents.permission_basis: Only discovery and bibliographic metadata is stored. Item wording and forms are excluded until the exact German version and reuse terms are verified.

cosmin_metrics.internal_consistency: Cronbach's alpha ca. .92 in nichtklinischen und ca. .92-.93 in klinischen Stichproben der Originalvalidierung.
cosmin_metrics.source: Beck AT, Steer RA, Brown GK (1996). Manual for the Beck Depression Inventory-II. Psychological Corporation.

versions.scoring_notes: 21 Items werden zum Gesamtscore summiert; Auswertung und Cutoffs folgen der lizenzierten deutschen Anleitung.
versions.psychometric_summary: BDI-II ist international umfangreich validiert; deutsche Normen und klinische Anwendung sind versionsabhängig.
